simulations.title: Og‘irlik kuchi ta’sirida jism harakati
simulations.description: Burchak ostida otish (parabola), vertikal yuqoriga va pastga otish, erkin tushish. Balandlik, tezlik va energiya grafiklari; uchish uzoqligi va maksimal balandlik.
simulations.keywords: og'irlik kuchi ta'sirida jism harakati gorizontga burchak ostida otilgan jism parabola trayektoriya uchish uzoqligi maksimal balandlik gorizontal otish vertikal otish yuqoriga otish pastga otish erkin tushish tezlanish g energiya projectile vertical motion free fall

simulations.title: Matematik mayatnik
simulations.description: Mayatnik tebranishi: aniq davr (elliptik integral) va kichik burchak formulasi, energiya, faza portreti, ishqalanish, majburiy tebranish va rezonans.
simulations.keywords: matematik mayatnik tebranish davr amplituda elliptik integral energiya faza portreti rezonans so'nish pendulum

simulations.title: Fizik mayatnik
simulations.description: Qattiq jism (sterjen, disk, halqa, shar) mayatnigi: inersiya momenti, Shteyner teoremasi, keltirilgan uzunlik, eng kichik davr va Keyter qo‘shma nuqtalari.
simulations.keywords: fizik mayatnik murakkab qattiq jism inersiya momenti shteyner keltirilgan uzunlik keyter tebranish markazi zarba markazi sterjen disk halqa physical pendulum

simulations.title: Prujinali mayatnik
simulations.description: Prujinali mayatnik: vertikal va gorizontal tebranish (bir tugma bilan almashtiriladi), Guk qonuni, davr T = 2π√(m/k), parallel va ketma-ket prujinalar, energiya, so'nish, majburiy tebranish va rezonans.
simulations.keywords: prujinali mayatnik prujina tebranish garmonik guk qonuni vertikal gorizontal parallel ketma-ket rezonans so'nish energiya davr spring

simulations.title: Mexanik to‘lqinlar va tovush
simulations.description: Ipdagi ko‘ndalang va bo‘ylama to‘lqinlar: to‘lqin uzunligi, impulsning qaytishi, turg‘un to‘lqinlar, qo‘lda tebratish. Suv sirtida interferensiya va yo‘llar farqi. Tovush va Doppler effekti, Max konusi, ovozni eshitish.
simulations.keywords: mexanik to'lqin ko'ndalang bo'ylama to'lqin uzunligi chastota davr tezlik qaytish turg'un to'lqin garmonika tugun do'nglik interferensiya kogerent yo'llar farqi tovush doppler effekti max konusi zarb to'lqini wave standing interference sound doppler

simulations.title: Aylana bo‘ylab harakat
simulations.description: Tekis va notekis aylanma harakat: chiziqli va burchak tezlik, davr, markazga intilma tezlanish, tezlik godografi va proyeksiyalar. Markazga intilma kuch: ipdagi sharcha (uzilish), burilishdagi avtomobil (ishqalanish, qiya yo‘l), vertikal halqa. Tasmali, tishli uzatma va velosiped.
params: Ip: v, m, R, F_max; ipni kesish
simulations.keywords: aylana bo'ylab harakat aylanma tekis notekis chiziqli tezlik burchak tezlik davr chastota markazga intilma tezlanish tangensial normal tezlanish godograf markazga intilma kuch ip taranglik burilish ishqalanish qiya yo'l vertikal halqa o'lik sirtmoq uzatma tasma tishli g'ildirak velosiped yulduzcha circular motion centripetal acceleration force banked curve loop gear

simulations.title: Butun olam tortishish qonuni
simulations.description: Laboratoriyadagi sharlar va osmon jismlari (Yer–Oy, Quyosh–Yer, XKS) orasidagi tortishish kuchi, tezlanishlar va orbita davri.
simulations.keywords: butun olam tortishish qonuni gravitatsiya nyuton orbita davri kepler yer oy quyosh gravitational

simulations.title: Nyuton qonunlari
simulations.description: Ikkinchi qonun: aravacha dinamometr yoki blok orqali osilgan yuk bilan tortiladi, fotodarvoza bilan a = 2s/t² o‘lchanadi, a(F) va a(1/m). Uchinchi qonun: prujinali ikki aravacha — F₁₂ = −F₂₁. Liftda vazn: ortiqcha yuklama va vaznsizlik.
params: Aravacha: F (o‘q suriladi), M va m («+»/«−»), μ, s
Ikki aravacha: m₁, m₂, prujina siqilishi
Lift: qavat pulti, odam massasi, tezlanish
simulations.keywords: nyuton qonunlari ikkinchi qonun uchinchi qonun f=ma kuch massa tezlanish ishqalanish ip tarangligi blok aravacha dinamometr ta'sir aks ta'sir impuls vazn og'irlik kuchi lift ortiqcha yuklama vaznsizlik erkin tushish newton laws weight elevator

simulations.title: Ish, quvvat va mexanik energiya
simulations.description: Mexanik ish A = Fs·cos α va ishqalanish ishi (ΣA = ΔEₖ), quvvat — ikki lebyodka musobaqasi. Skeytparkda energiyaning saqlanishi va issiqlikka aylanishi, E(x) diagrammasi. Prujinali otgich: kx²/2 = mgH, k ni o‘lchash.
params: Tortish: F va α (o‘q uchi suriladi), m, μ, s (bayroq)
Skeytpark: yo‘l shakli (nuqtalar suriladi), m, μ, g, Eₚ = 0 sathi
Otgich: k, m, siqilish x (sharcha suriladi)
simulations.keywords: mexanik ish quvvat energiya kinetik potensial energiya saqlanish qonuni ishqalanish issiqlik skeytpark prujina energiyasi bikrlik lebyodka vatt joul work power energy conservation skate park

simulations.title: Suyuqlik va gaz harakati
simulations.description: Oqim uzluksizligi Q = Sv: kesimlari suriladigan quvur, hajmi saqlanadigan «bo‘lak». Bernulli qonuni: to‘rtta manometr, energiya chizig‘i, Venturi trubkasi, bosimning atmosferadan pasayishi. Qo‘llanishlar: Torichelli formulasi, qanotning ko‘tarish kuchi (bosim xaritasi), purkagich.
params: Quvur: Q (dastak), d₁, d₂, d₃ (devor tutqichlari)
Bernulli: Q, tor joy d₂, kirish bosimi (1-manometr), ko‘tarilish Δy
Torichelli: suv sathi H, teshik balandligi, 1 yoki 3 teshik
Qanot: oqim tezligi V, hujum burchagi α (chiqish qirrasi suriladi)
Purkagich: havo tezligi v, naycha balandligi
simulations.keywords: suyuqlik gaz harakati gidrodinamika aerodinamika oqim uzluksizligi sarf kesim tezlik bernulli qonuni tenglamasi bosim manometr venturi trubkasi torichelli formulasi teshikdan oqish samolyot qanoti ko'tarish kuchi hujum burchagi jukovskiy purkagich atomayzer pulverizator fluid flow continuity bernoulli venturi torricelli airfoil lift
